exclusions: Persona preference lists have no chronology and are vocabulary sources only.
ImplicitMemBench procedural and feedback memories are not PreferenceMemory conflict events.
Synthetic policy cases are reported separately and never enter incidence denominators.

decisionRules.adjudicationApiTrigger: Do not design a first-class adjudication API unless at least 20 same-slot changes exist and either recency-appropriate rate is below 0.90 or ambiguous conflicts affect more than 0.05 of preference-bearing scopes.
decisionRules.underpowered: Fewer than 20 natural same-slot changes, or a corpus without frozen identity slots, is underpowered. Report underpowered_no_adjudication and do not use it to claim that conflicts are absent in production.
decisionRules.unavailableIdentityMetrics: When the current extractor exposes only legacy categories, report same-slot, recency-appropriateness, and ambiguity metrics as null. Never substitute same-category changes for same-slot changes.

detector.note: The census reports what the checked-in deterministic extractor recognizes. It is not a high-recall production incidence estimator.
